item.title: ▫️ To make it automatic is what saves lives in battle At the training grounds of the Tsentr Group of Forces, servicemen are trained to provide first aid to the wounded
item.description: To make it automatic is what saves lives in battle At the training grounds of the Tsentr Group of Forces, servicemen are trained to provide first aid to the wounded quickly and without fuss. ▫️ The combat lifesaving training takes quite a long time. It’s not enough to just know how to put on tourniquets and bandages; immense endurance is required. In addition to a bulletproof vest, a rifle, and basic combat kit, a combat lifesaver carries a medical pack weighing about 30 kg. ✅ Making fast decisions with that kind of weight on you, especially under fire, is difficult both physically and mentally. That's why, in training, all actions are practised to perfection, so that, at a critical moment, the fighter does everything right. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:

To make it automatic is what saves lives in battle
At the training grounds of the Tsentr Group of Forces, servicemen are trained to provide first aid to the wounded
quickly and without fuss.
▫️
The combat lifesaving training takes quite a long time.
It’s not enough to just know how to put on tourniquets and bandages; immense endurance is required.
In addition to a bulletproof vest, a rifle, and basic combat kit, a combat lifesaver carries a medical pack weighing about 30 kg.
✅
Making fast decisions with that kind of weight on you, especially under fire, is difficult both physically and mentally.
That's why, in training, all actions are practised to perfection, so that, at a critical moment, the fighter does everything right.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🔥 We detect and burn down A counter-UAV platoon leader of the 103rd Motorised Rifle Regiment (Yuzhnaya Group of Forces) with the call sign 'Pioner'
item.description: 🔥 We detect and burn down A counter-UAV platoon leader of the 103rd Motorised Rifle Regiment (Yuzhnaya Group of Forces) with the call sign 'Pioner' spoke about the combat work of his unit in Slavyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration: 'Our main tasks remain the same as they were in Konstantinovka: countering airborne threats, countering heavy UAVs, and destroying launch sites near Alekseyevo-Druzhkovka, Druzhkovka, and Kramatorsk. If the mission requires to neutralise an enemy stronghold or an important heavy UAV launch site, we operate in coordination with artillery units and destroy the launch point.' 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to deliver strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles at the defence industry enterprises and logistics centres, as well as ships
item.description: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue to deliver strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles at the defence industry enterprises and logistics centres, as well as ships operating in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. 💥 As a result of the strike, the following targets were hit: ▫️ in Kiev region – the logistics centre (HAVI Logistics Ukraine) in Trebukhov, the territory of which was used by units of the Ministry of Defence and other security structures of Ukraine to store dual-use goods; ▫️ in Kiev – DataGroup data centre, which was responsible for processing and transmitting intelligence data in the interests of the AFU; ▫️ in Odessa region – a dry cargo ship that delivered military cargo to the port of Chernomorsk. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ⏩ Andrei Belousov inspects Sever Group of Forces: the security zone is expanding As part of a working visit to the special military operation zone, Russian Defence Minister Andrei
item.description: Andrei Belousov inspects Sever Group of Forces: the security zone is expanding As part of a working visit to the special military operation zone, Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov visited the command post of one of the Sever Group's formations. During the visit, the head of the military department was informed by commanders on situation within their designated areas of responsibility. ⏩ Commander of the Sever Group of Forces Colonel General Yevgeny Nikiforov reported to the Minister of Defence on successful actions aimed at creation of a security zone in the border areas of Sumy and Kharkov regions. 'In particular, in Sumy direction, 10 settlements and more than 250 km² of territory are liberated. We press on with offensive operations to liberate four more settlements,' the Commander of the Sever Group of Forces reported. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 💬 To servicemen who liberated Dobropolye Maloye: this victory continues the heroic path of the division — Andrei Belousov
item.description: To servicemen who liberated Dobropolye Maloye: this victory continues the heroic path of the division — Andrei Belousov 💬 The Russian Defence Minister congratulated the command and personnel of the 76th Guards Chernigov Red Banner Order of Suvorov Air Assault Division as part of the 51st Army on the liberation of Dobropolye Maloye in the Donetsk People's Republic. 'This victory continues the heroic path of the division and will forever remain a symbol of courage and resilience for the next generation of defenders of the Motherland,' the head of the department stressed, addressing the fighters. 🤝 Andrei Belousov thanked the servicemen for successfully carrying out combat missions and loyalty to military duty , and expressed confidence that the servicemen of the division would honourably continue to carry out all assigned tasks, reliably defend national interests, and ensure Russia's security. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29609

To servicemen who liberated Dobropolye Maloye: this victory continues the heroic path of the division — Andrei Belousov
💬
The Russian Defence Minister congratulated the command and personnel of the 76th Guards Chernigov Red Banner Order of Suvorov Air Assault Division as part of the 51st Army on the liberation of Dobropolye Maloye in the Donetsk People's Republic.
'This victory continues the heroic path of the division and will forever remain a symbol of courage and resilience for the next generation of defenders of the Motherland,' the head of the department stressed, addressing the fighters.
🤝
Andrei Belousov
thanked the servicemen for successfully carrying out combat missions and loyalty to military duty
, and expressed confidence that the servicemen of the division would honourably continue to carry out all assigned tasks, reliably defend national interests, and ensure Russia's security.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
⚡️
From 19 to 25 September, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out two mass strikes and seven group strikes
, as a result of which fire damage was inflicted on military plants, metallurgical industry enterprises, along with fuel and power facilities of Ukraine that kept them running, logistics and telecommunication centres,️ transport infrastructure facilities used in the interests of the AFU,️ military airfields,️ UAV production and storage areas,️ ammunition, fuel, and military hardware depots,️ temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed groups and foreign mercenaries.
💥
In addition, the strikes disabled a number of facilities of the infrastructure of the Ukrainian ports
, which provided for the reception, storage and distribution of military cargo, as well as fuel and lubricants used in the interests of the AFU.
▪️
During the week, Russian troops hit 18 ships, including 15 dry cargo ships and three tankers involved in supplying Western weapons, military hardware, and fuel to the Armed Forces of Ukraine.
💥
Units of the Sever Group of Forces continue to tighten the encirclement of the enemy's formations
in the north-east of Kharkov region and expand the external control zone.
🚩
Last week, as a result of active and resolute actions, the settlements of Buzovo, Komissarovo, Krasny Yar, Loshakovo, Novoaleksandrovka, Polnaya, Potikhonovo, and Khiznyakovo (Kharkov region) were taken under Russian control. All the enemy's attempts to break through the encirclement were thwarted.
▪️
Over the past week, the enemy has lost over 250 militants, seven armoured fighting vehicles, three motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and five UGVs.
▪️
A total of 212 square kilometres of territory and 12 settlements have been liberated
since the beginning of the AFU group's encirclement in the north-east of Kharkov region.
More than 960 troops, 23 armoured fighting vehicles, 13 motor vehicles, 13 ATVs, and 28 UGVs were neutralised.
💥
In addition,
seven mechanised brigades, two motorised infantry brigades, one airmobile brigade, one artillery brigade, two assault regiments, one unmanned systems regiment of the AFU, six territorial defence brigades, and one national guard brigade were hit in Sumy and Kharkov regions.
▪️
Over the past week, in the Sever Group's area of responsibility, the enemy has lost more than 1,490 troops, 11 armoured fighting vehicles, 107 motor vehicles, four field artillery guns, and three electronic warfare stations.
📍
During the week, units of the Zapad Group of Forces have taken more advantageous lines and positions.
Strikes were delivered at formations of four mechanised brigades, one assault brigade, one airmobile brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, and two territorial defence brigades were hit.
▪️
The AFU losses in this direction amounted to more than 1,510 troops, 13 armoured fighting vehicles, including five U.S.-made M113 armoured personnel carriers, 92 motor vehicles, 13 field artillery guns, and five electronic warfare stations and counter-fire radars.
📍
Last week, units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Manpower and hardware of five mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, one assault brigade, one mountain assault brigade, two airmobile brigades, one assault regiment of the AFU, one marine brigade, two territorial defence brigades, and one national guard brigade were hit.
▪️
In total, in the Yuzhnaya Group's area of responsibility, the enemy has lost more than 1,340 troops, three tanks, including one German-made Leopard tank, 10 armoured fighting vehicles, 148 motor vehicles, and 20 field artillery guns.
👉

🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
